description: Per-line blame of a postgres file at any commit (code-history index): the commit that wrote each line, as `git blame` with git's default diff. ignore_revs (default true) passes through the pgindent/reformat commits of .git-blame-ignore-revs when they replaced lines one-for-one; reverse adds the commit that removed each line later on the version's branch. At most 2000 lines per call; commits lists author, date and subject per short sha. Not the same as git_blame, which returns a file's commit history.

repository.description: Repository; only postgres is in the code-history index for now (the default).

reverse.description: Also name the commit that later removed each line (default false)

version.description: Commit to read: a SHA or 7+ hex prefix, a branch (master, REL_17_STABLE), a tag (REL_17_0), a major (17, 9.6), a release (17.2), <ref>@YYYY-MM-DD (the branch's last commit by that day), or <ref>~N. Default: the newest release branch's head.

name: blame
